title: James Webb Reveals a 1‑Mile‑Wide Alien Moon

scenes.text: James Webb spotted a moon larger than Earth’s moon in a distant exoplanet system

scenes.label: LARGER THAN OUR MOON
scenes.text: The moon is about 1,000 km across, nearly 2.5 times larger than our Moon

scenes.label: ROCKY SURFACE
scenes.text: Spectral data suggest a rocky composition similar to Earth’s crust

scenes.label: PERIODIC ORBITS
scenes.text: It orbits its star every 120 days, staying within the habitable zone
Follow to feed your curious mind daily.

description: James Webb’s latest snapshot shows a massive, rocky moon orbiting a distant planet. This could hint at complex satellite systems beyond our Solar System. Follow for daily science!
